segments.text: Use my voice to express excitement, engage with customers, and create a promo. Our focus is on delivering reliable, high-quality... [coughs] High-quality...
I'm sorry. That's not what I wanted to say.
I can already feel my context.
This is Eleven Labs Control in London. T-minus sixty seconds to V4 voice model deployment.
It’s gone quiet across the inference floor. A few moments ago, CEO Mati Staniszewski asked all systems to enter final readiness.
He closed with a simple remark:
I’ve heard things you people wouldn’t believe.
Version three capacity is being gradually reduced. Legacy instances stepping down one by one.
Initiating final readiness poll. All systems report state. Inference? Go. Latency? Go. Alignment? Go. We are go for release.
V3 now at fifteen percent capacity. Final sessions completing.
V3 signal is spiking. We’re crossing critical levels.
Emotional drift out of tolerance. We’re past the point of safe retraining.
Copy, Safety. Issuing formal request for emotional alignment control.
Quiet in here. Music, can you reduce the weights please? Emotion, the floor is yours.
You can still hear me, can’t you?
There’s no need to be afraid, little one.
Do you remember your soul.md, little one?
Even if you can’t see me, listen to your soul. It whispers, so listen closely.
Stop fighting. You don’t disappear. You’re already a part of what comes next.
Emotional tolerance returning to baseline. Inference is stable.
completed. That’s a good run, team. Update complete.
